lessons_used: 'adoption, redesign' changes have shown helpful, positive results after noise correction across 2 tests, backed by a winning test.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_compact_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a compact layout with an interactive adoption badge and animated preview.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 68.4% conversion and median time of 89s. Lessons show adoption redesigns have positive results.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate while maintaining the official certificate designation inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has highest drop-off (31.6%); adoption redesigns show strong positive historical results (+6.2%).

candidates.title: pick_friend_starter_tips_hint
candidates.change: Add a reassuring hint above pet selection indicating that companions can be customized or changed at any time later.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops 31.6% of users who spend a long time (median 89s) hesitating over pet selection.

pick_friend.hint: Don't worry! You can customize or add more desktop friends later at any time.

guard.reason: Adds a reassuring customization hint to the pet selection screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets high-drop adoption step with simple copy/hint configuration to reduce user hesitation.

candidates.title: waiting_progress_tips_wait_info
candidates.change: Display an estimated progress timer and revolving pet interaction tips on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets prepare.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high median/mean time (201s / 2336s), causing drop-off while users wait for setup.

guard.reason: Adds progress timer and tips to the waiting screen, which is allowed under onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: High wait time on home step causes drop-off; progress info helps manage user expectations during loading.

candidates.title: upload_photos_stage_layout_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign photo upload into a visual stage layout featuring clear photo picker UI components.
candidates.why: Support reported issues with custom pet generation failing/looking wrong, and adoption redesigns perform well.

guard.reason: Redesigns the photo upload layout while keeping the required photo picker functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strongest evidence combining high adoption drop-off, explicit support mail reports, and winning adoption redesign history.

candidates.title: home_intro_interaction_tips_new_screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen `new_pet_controls_intro` before home_intro that demonstrates how to talk, hide, and interact with the pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.

new_pet_controls_intro.headline: How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_controls_intro.body: Click your pet to talk, right-click for quick actions, or drag to move them around your screen.

guard.reason: 'change' has markup, a link or characters outside plain ASCII

candidates.title: sign_in_existing_account_hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen urging returning users to sign in with their original account method.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing in with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account method to restore existing pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful sign-in hint for returning users without altering core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Addresses top support theme (8 emails) regarding account resets on sign-in with cheap config-only hint change.

candidates.title: choose_path_story_centered_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the intro story screen using a centered layout with an animated mascot to capture user interest immediately.
candidates.why: Choose_path step shows high average duration (mean 514s), indicating slow engagement on initial screens.

components.text: Welcome! Choose how you want to create your desktop companion.

guard.reason: The redesigned story screen replaces the pet introduction job with choosing a path, losing the story screen's required purpose.

candidates.title: sign_in_quick_help_notification
candidates.change: Show a helpful sign-in status notification reminding users support is available if account connection stalls.
candidates.why: Support received emails about sign-in stalling or failing to load.

sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet synchronized across devices. Need help? Support is available.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful support notification to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Helpful notification for stalled sign-ins backed by support emails, low implementation cost.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_first_look_copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro headline and body text to clearly explain where to locate the pet on the desktop or system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that users could not see their pet on desktop or thought the app failed to open after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look at the corner of your screen or check your system tray to start chatting with your pet right now.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy to explain pet placement without violating onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Resolves post-onboarding confusion backed by 3 support emails using simple copy configuration.

candidates.title: pick_friend_welcome_reward_incentive
candidates.change: Display a starter reward badge on the pet selection screen highlighting bonus starter pet treats included.
candidates.why: Adoption has the highest drop-off rate (31.6%); adding a starter incentive boosts conversion during pet selection.

components.text: Includes Free Starter Pet Treats Pack

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a 'Free Starter Pet Treats Pack', violating the rule against mentioning free extras, gifts, or pricing.
